meta.name: poetry-music-visual
meta.description: 为古诗词提供配图与配乐的全流程创作指导；支持深度解析诗词意境、生成画面描述、提供配乐创作蓝图（Suno格式）；适用于诗词可视化、MV创作、文化传播等场景

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为古诗词生成配图与配乐创作方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把古诗词转化为视听作品
copy.tagline_en: Generate visual and music creation plans for classical poetry
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to transform classical poetry into audiovisual works

howto.what: 当用户为古诗词请求配图或配乐时，Claude 会先解析诗的意象、情感与文化背景，再生成 2-3 组画面描述和一份 Suno 格式的纯音乐创作蓝图，最后整合两者保证艺术风格统一。
howto.when: 当用户要求为古诗词配图、配乐或制作诗词MV时触发。

say.text: 给李白的《静夜思》写配图和配乐方案
say.note: Claude 会解析诗意并生成画面与音乐蓝图

say.text: 为《山居秋暝》生成 Suno 风格的纯音乐结构
say.note: 它会输出风格标签和结构指令

say.text: 帮我给这首古诗做 MV 的视觉和音乐设计
say.note: 会同时产出配图描述和配乐蓝图

howto.what_en: When asked to illustrate or score a classical Chinese poem, Claude parses its imagery, emotion, and culture, generates 2-3 visual scene descriptions and a Suno-format music blueprint, then unifies them.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests image accompaniment, music, or a poetry MV for a classical Chinese poem.

say_en.text: Make image and music plans for Li Bai's 'Quiet Night Thought'.
say_en.note: Claude parses the poem and outputs visuals and music.

say_en.text: Generate a Suno-format instrumental blueprint for 'Dwelling in Autumn Hills'.
say_en.note: It outputs style tags and structure instructions.

say_en.text: Design the visual and musical direction for a MV of this poem.
say_en.note: It will produce both image description and music blueprint.
